data.one_liner: Spring-based physics hero transitions and gesture-driven animations in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Heroine enables smooth spring-based hero transitions between routes with customizable bounce, drag-to-dismiss gestures, and velocity-aware animations. It integrates with Flutter's navigation system via a navigator observer and offers various shuttle builders for advanced transition effects.
use_when: You want spring-based, physics-driven hero animations instead of default Flutter curves.
You need drag-to-dismiss interactions for detail views.
You require customizable flight shuttle builders like 3D flips or color fades during transitions.
avoid_when: You are looking for state management or dependency injection libraries.
You want non-interactive, standard page transitions without hero elements.
strengths: Provides smooth spring-based physics and velocity-aware animations.
Supports drag-to-dismiss gestures out of the box.
Offers flexible transition effects with chainable shuttle builders.
weaknesses: Does not support nested transitions (though nesting heroines not part of the same transition is allowed).
Requires proper registration of `HeroineController` in navigators.
data.setup_notes: Register `HeroineController()` in your app's navigator observers (e.g., `MaterialApp(navigatorObservers: [HeroineController()])`).
